Paragraph: Hanuma on going from Mt. Rishyamuka to Mt. Malaya, has reported to the king of monkeys Sugreeva, about the two valiant Raghava-s.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hanuman returns to report the outcome of his reconnaissance and initial meeting with the princes.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman successfully bridges communication between the exiles and the monkey king.
Outcome/Resolution: Sugreeva is informed of the presence and disposition of Rama and Lakshmana.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Doota Karma (faithful execution of a messenger's duty)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman serves as the ideal intermediary, delivering vital news that initiates a dharmic alliance.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Effective communication flow and reliable reporting between team members.
